lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਛਿੰਗਾ ਆਪੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape jal aape de chhi(n)gaa aape chulee bharaavai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the water, He Himself gives the tooth-pick, and He Himself offers the mouthwash.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਿ ਬਹਾਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sa(n)gat sad bahaalai aape vidaa karaavai ||
lines.translation: He Himself calls and seats the congregation, and He Himself bids them goodbye.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kirapaal hovai har aape tis no hukam manaavai ||6||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy - the Lord causes him to walk according to His Will. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam sabh ba(n)dhanaa paap pu(n)n sanaba(n)dh ||
lines.translation: Rituals and religions are all just entanglements; bad and good are bound up with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੁ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mamataa mohu s ba(n)dhanaa putr kalatr s dha(n)dh ||
lines.translation: Those things done for the sake of children and spouse, in ego and attachment, are just more bonds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa tah jevaree maaiaa kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there I see the noose of attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sache naam bin varatan varatai a(n)dh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, the world is engrossed in blind entanglements. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe chaanan taa theeai jaa satigur milai rajaai ||
lines.translation: The blind receive the Divine Light, when they merge with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRai sach vasai agiaan adheraa jaai ||
lines.translation: They break their bonds, and dwell in Truth, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh dekhai tisai kaa jin keeaa tan saaj ||
lines.translation: They see that everything belongs to the One who created and fashioned the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran karataar kee karataa raakhai laaj ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Creator - the Creator preserves his honor. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਟੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਤਦਹੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਬੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jadahu aape thaat keeaa bahi karatai tadahu puchh na sevak beeaa ||
lines.translation: When the Creator, sitting all by Himself, created the Universe, he did not consult with any of His servants;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਦਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tadahu kiaa ko levai kiaa ko devai jaa(n) avar na doojaa keeaa ||
lines.translation: so what can anyone take, and what can anyone give, when He did not create any other like Himself?

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir aape jagat upaaiaa karatai daan sabhanaa kau deeaa ||
lines.translation: Then, after fashioning the world, the Creator blessed all with His blessings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਬਣਾਈਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sev banaaeean guramukh aape a(n)mrit peeaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself instructs us in His service, and as Gurmukh, we drink in His Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aap nira(n)kaar aakaar hai aape aape karai s theeaa ||7||
lines.translation: He Himself is formless, and He Himself is formed; whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh prabh sevahi sad saachaa anadin sahaj piaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs serve God forever; night and day, they are steeped in the Love of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਰਧਿ ਉਰਧਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d gaavahi gun saache aradh uradh ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: They are in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; in this world and in the next, they keep Him clasped to their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar preetam vasiaa dhur karam likhiaa karataar ||
lines.translation: Their Beloved dwells deep within; the Creator pre-ordained this destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap milaaian aape kirapaa dhaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He blends them into Himself; He Himself showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਐ ਕਥਿਐ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahiai kathiai na paaeeai anadin rahai sadaa gun gaai ||
lines.translation: By merely talking and speaking, He is not found. Night and day, sing His Glorious Praises continually.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin karamai kinai na paaio bhauk mue bilalaai ||
lines.translation: Without His Merciful Grace, no one finds Him; many have died barking and bewailing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਿਜੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man tan bhijai aap vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: When the mind and body are saturated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord Himself comes to dwell in his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai aape lae milaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, He is found; He unites us in His Union. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੈ ਆਪਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape ved puraan sabh saasat aap kathai aap bheejai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Vedas, the Puraanas and all the Shaastras; He Himself chants them, and He Himself is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਪੂਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee bahi pooje karataa aap parapa(n)ch kareejai ||
lines.translation: He Himself sits down to worship, and He Himself creates the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap paravirat aap niraviratee aape akath katheejai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is a householder, and He Himself is a renunciate; He Himself utters the Unutterable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape pu(n)n sabh aap karaae aap alipat varateejai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is all goodness, and He Himself causes us to act; He Himself remains detached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: aape sukh dukh devai karataa aape bakhas kareejai ||8||
lines.translation: He Himself grants pleasure and pain; the Creator Himself bestows His gifts. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਭਉ ਕਰਿ ਝਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sekhaa a(n)darahu jor chhad too bhau kar jhal gavaai ||
lines.translation: O Shaykh, abandon your cruel nature; live in the Fear of God and give up your madness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bhai kete nisatare bhai vich nirabhau paai ||
lines.translation: Through the Fear of the Guru, many have been saved; in this fear, find the Fearless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kathor sabad bhed too(n) saa(n)t vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: Pierce your stone heart with the Word of the Shabad; let peace and tranquility come to abide in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)tee vich kaar kamaavanee saa khasam paae thaai ||
lines.translation: If good deeds are done in this state of peace, they are approved by the Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaam krodh kinai na paaio puchhahu giaanee jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through sexual desire and anger, no one has ever found God - go, and ask any wise man. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:
